text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although they lost the Aoharu Cup, the 
team's valiant efforts saved the hearts of 
Riko Kashimoto and her teammates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Receiving Chairwoman Akikawa's words of 
appreciation, <chrname> and I pledged to keep doing 
our best going forward.
